data.narrative:
Velaura AI is a Series C semiconductor company that has raised $343M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 8 private-stage peers in Chips & Semiconductors (including Tenstorrent, Nearfield Instruments, Positron AI, and DEEPX) and 3 public semiconductor benchmarks (ALAB, NVDA, AMD).

Two triangulation methods proved applicable. Stage-progression, anchoring to $343M in total raised and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, implies $583M. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comps yields a $1.3B midpoint, with a range spanning $529M (DEEPX, Series C) to $2.7B (Tenstorrent, Series D). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (18.9x median across the three public tickers) was not applicable due to absence of target revenue disclosure, standard for private companies.

The two-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $496M (low) to $1.5B (high), with a median of $942M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage comparability: peer valuations span from $529M to $2.7B, and the stage-progression method sits materially below peer medians, suggesting either conservative capital deployment or market repricing of semiconductor valuations since Velaura's earlier fundraising. Revenue visibility and unit economics remain critical to narrowing this range.
